_comment: Right Path Servicing-Agent Onboarding — OUTREACH CADENCE / NONRESPONSIVE decision. Part of the established GoRules ZEN decision layer (adapted from the IPF ZEN pattern in src/rules/next-best-action.json). ZEN owns the BUSINESS JUDGMENT about the state of an outreach run given its attempt history; the deterministic day-math (next call date, business-day rotation) stays in TypeScript (src/lib/stewardship/call-cadence.ts), per the settled division of labor. This decision takes normalized attempt facts the TS layer derives from the grouped communication history and emits the cadence status: whether the run has reached the point of being flagged 'Nonresponsive — Review Contact Strategy'. CRITICAL SETTLED RULES: the flag is a RECOMMENDATION ONLY — it never stops outreach, never closes the item, and never changes the queue on its own. The cadence continues indefinitely; a human decides whether to continue, change strategy, defer, or stop. ZEN here decides ONLY the status/recommendation, not any terminal action.

rules._description: Seven or more unsuccessful outreach attempts: flag the run 'Nonresponsive — Review Contact Strategy'. This is a RECOMMENDATION for a human to reconsider the contact information, the communication method, or the timing. It does NOT stop outreach, close the item, or change the queue; the cadence keeps producing next-attempt dates and a person decides what to do.
Fewer than seven unsuccessful attempts: the run is in its normal automatic cadence. Keep attempting on the computed schedule.
